title: purchase (native to page)
description: Outcome of the purchase sheet. The native app never acknowledges the purchase: the server does after verifying it.

result.description: purchased: Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED. pending: PurchaseState.PENDING (e.g. cash payment). canceled: USER_CANCELED. already_owned: ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED. unavailable: BILLING_UNAVAILABLE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE or FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED. error: anything else.

message.description: Developer-facing detail, never shown to the customer.
